15	def _stable_permutation(metric):
16	    """Return a stable permutation that sorts `metric` in descending order.
17	    Uses an index-based jitter to break ties deterministically."""
18	    n = ops.shape(metric)[0]
19	    idx = ops.arange(0, n, dtype="int32")
20	    # tiny jitter = (idx / n) * 1e-12 so it never flips a real strict ordering
21	    jitter = ops.divide(ops.cast(idx, "float32"), ops.cast(n, "float32"))
22	    metric_jittered = ops.add(metric, ops.multiply(jitter, 1e-12))
23	    # argsort by negative to get descending
24	    return ops.argsort(ops.negative(metric_jittered))
